leadText:
Shimmering Season (Korean: 찬란한 계절 Challanhan Gyejeol) is the fourth and final opening theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon the Series: Black & White. It debuted in BW123, replacing We Are One. It was also used as the opening theme for BWS01 and BWS02. It uses the same footage as its corresponding Japanese opening theme, Summerly Slope.

The full version of this song was used as the opening theme for the Korean dub of Genesect and the Legend Awakened.

Pocket Monsters...
"Pokémon" for short!
Now, the story of the meeting between the boy and Pokémon.
The story of their exciting adventures
Is beginning! 

===Synopsis===
 
The animation begins underwater with bubbles rising to the surface and an and swim across the screen from opposite directions. The scene glows and changes to the Best Wishes! 2 logo rising out of the water. The logo then moves up the screen and the words "Decolora Adventure" and "Da!" are added onto the logo. The scene changes to show clouds, which part to reveal a sun that shines on a ship where , , , and are. The camera zooms into the gang and then quickly changes to the water surface as the ship races along. The scene changes to a birds-eye view of a town and the camera moves down to a bed of sunflowers. A appears and turns around to face the camera. Then the scene changes to Pikachu and Ash jumping over puddles, followed by Iris, Axew, Cilan and as they run. The scene then shows a field of grass filled with , , and flying and . Next, it shows the ship at a distance as the sun falls in the horizon, and then shows a closer shot of Porter, and on the ship, as , and fly next to the ship. The scene changes to a Basculin submarine and then to the Team Rocket trio inside as they paddle along. The screen turns red, which alarms Team Rocket, and their mecha rises up to the surface. As Team Rocket appear, they realize the boat is being held by a and Team Rocket flees in fright. The scene then changes to a montage of various people and Pokémon, first showing Chili and , then Cress and , then Alexa, and , then Clair and her Shiny . A red lightning flashes across the scene and reveals Nurse Joy from both the past generations (with ) and from the current series (with ). A blue lightning flashes and reveals Officer Jenny from both the past generations (with ) and from the current series (with ). The scene changes to some mountains at night and a shooting star falls across the screen. , , and suddenly jump into the screen, and a spirals diagonally across the screen. The scene changes to Ash and the gang coming to a cliff edge, and the camera quickly cuts to the view of the water and islands and then rises to the sun. A quickly flies into the sun, and the scene changes to show ad Mimey watering and cleaning the garden at her house. Delia looks up and the scene changes to and sketching a drowsing with a floating above. The camera then moves up to the sun and quickly cuts to a close up of Ash as Pikachu jumps on his shoulder. Ash and Pikachu then laugh and the scene changes to a still picture of Ash, Pikachu, Iris, Axew, Cilan, Pansage, Clair, Alexa, Gogoat, Helioptile, Professor Oak and Porter.

! Korean
! English

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 
 

On the land that greets me lies sun-filled warmth

Taking light steps on the unfamiliar landscape
A breathtaking journey is beginning

I'll remember you even when this season ends

==Trivia==
The song was uploaded by the official Korean YouTube channel on November 27, 2013.
The song was used in trailers for the Korean and Thai dubs of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon, as well as the opening theme for the sneak preview of SM001 in the Korean dub.
